provenance.title: Public replenishment opportunity model
provenance.trainingData: Instacart 2017 anonymized public orders, archived by Xiaoyu Wang (2019)
provenance.datasetScope: Public data only; 45000 training and 5000 development households selected independently of application users. No SKU, user identifiers, titles, physical amounts or private household data in model features.
provenance.task: Next observed shopping-day product presence; application seven-day use is an adaptation.
